description: Implementation of the Android ActivityManager class, providing methods to interact with the activity service, manage UIDs, and handle service connection lifecycle.

classes.name: ActivityManager
classes.description: Provides methods to access and manage the activity service, including UID observation and permission checks.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the activity service, waiting if necessary until it becomes available.

methods.name: openContentUri
methods.description: Opens a content URI via the activity service.

methods.name: registerUidObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for UID-related events.

methods.name: registerUidObserverForUids
methods.description: Registers an observer for specific UIDs.

methods.name: addUidToObserver
methods.description: Adds a UID to an existing observer.

methods.name: removeUidFromObserver
methods.description: Removes a UID from an observer.

methods.name: isUidActive
methods.description: Checks if a UID is active.

methods.name: getUidProcessState
methods.description: Retrieves the process state for a UID.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Checks if a permission is granted for a process and UID.

methods.name: linkToDeath
methods.description: Links a death recipient to the activity service binder.

methods.name: unlinkToDeath
methods.description: Unlinks a death recipient from the activity service binder.
